<b>Ascendant's Grip</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It allows [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to stick to walls while using [[Cling Grip]].

== Usefulness ==
Ascendant's Grip causes [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to stick in place while clinging to a wall rather than sliding down the surface. The effect can be cancelled by releasing movement inputs after clinging to a wall. The effect is not instantaneous; falling from high up before clinging to a wall will cause Hornet to slide down the wall a short distance before stopping.

Ascendant's Grip is very useful in platforming sections that require a lot of wall movement. It can also be used to stall in the air during arena fights by clinging to a wall.

== How to Acquire ==
Sold by [[Jubilana]] in [[Songclave]] for {{R|350}}.
